title: Creatine Gummies: 4 of 6 Tested Brands Had Almost No Creatine
description: Independent labs bought creatine gummies off the shelf and measured what was inside. Two had none detectable, two had trace amounts. Here is what the trial and the tests show, plus how to read the label before you buy. #CreatineGummies #Creatine #SupplementTesting #SportsNutrition #FuelnFitHub
